locations.title: Wind Farm Cross-Country
locations.description:
This Cross-Country route has it all: rough, uneven terrain; big jumps; water splashes; and a final dash along the sand to the finish.

**Restriction:** Class C 500 Pickups & 4x4s

locations.title: Temple Cross-Country
locations.description:
Starting at the Horizon Festival, carve your way through the steep banked turns and aim for a perfect landing as you fly towards the final stretch.

**Prerequisite:** Yellow Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class B 600 Total AWD

locations.title: Stadium Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
Race in and around the Horizon Stadium as you tackle the custom-built raised roads, crossovers and huge jumps.

**Prerequisite:** Green Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class B 600 Total Rally

locations.title: City Docks Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
The Tokyo City Docks are the star here. Weave through shipping containers around this sharp-cornered circuit.

**Prerequisite:** Green Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class B 600 Total Rally

locations.title: Shinjuku Gyoen Cross-Country
locations.description:
Race towards Tokyo City cutting Cross-Country through water sections and over daring jumps.

**Prerequisite:** Green Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class B 600 Heavy Hitters

locations.title: Shimanoyama Cross-Country
locations.description:
Cut through the long grass of the Shimanoyama Region before bursting into the Horizon Stadium to wow the crowds as you speed up the raised platforms.

**Prerequisite:** Blue Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Sports Utility Heroes

locations.title: Oka Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
Traverse the underpasses in the Hokubu Region around this short but fast circuit. Watch for those banks and jumps.

**Prerequisite:** Blue Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Unlimited Off-Road

locations.title: Snow Forest Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
Take on the slopes around the Sotoyama Ski Resort in this fast-paced Cross-Country Circuit.

**Prerequisite:** Blue Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

locations.title: Takashiro Cross-Country
locations.description:
Hurtle off-road through the Takashiro Region taking on sweeping banked turns, steep inclines and a full-tilt downhill charge to the finish.

**Prerequisite:** Pink Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

locations.title: Soni Highlands Cross-Country
locations.description:
Charge across the Takashiro and Hokubu Regions over mixed terrain and one of the most breathtaking jumps at Horizon Japan.

**Prerequisite:** Pink Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Total Buggies & Off-Road

locations.title: Naruo Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
Fly like an eagle as you tear around the fairways of the Naruo Golf Course.

**Prerequisite:** Pink Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Class A 700 Unlimited Buggies

locations.title: Nangan Cross-Country Circuit
locations.description:
Take on huge jumps and long, sweeping banked corners as you circle around Irokawa Space Centre.

**Prerequisite:** Orange Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Modern Rally Cars

locations.title: Izu Cross-Country
locations.description:
After an exhilarating freefall drop through the Kawazu Nandaru Loop Bridge you'll be fighting for traction on the long open corners.

**Prerequisite:** Orange Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Sports Utility Heroes

locations.title: Yahikoyama Cross-Country
locations.description:
Wide, flowing turns through the flower fields before touching down on Ito Airfield for a twisting race to the finish.

**Prerequisite:** Orange Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Unlimited Off-Road

locations.description:
Race around Tokyo City as you tackle jumps, split carriageways and a trick final hairpin that can make or break your race position.

**Prerequisite:** Purple Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Sports Utility Heroes

locations.description:
Charge down the Sotoyama ski runs before free-falling into the Takashiro Region and going fully off-road.

**Prerequisite:** Purple Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Unlimited Off-Road

locations.description:
Descend from the snowy Sotoyama Region before lining up for a series of jumps across the plains to finish.

**Prerequisite:** Purple Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Total Buggies & Off-Road

locations.description:
Contend with the terrain on Legend Island as you leap off hills and drift around tight corners.

**Prerequisite:** Gold Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Pickups & 4x4s

locations.description:
The ultimate Cross-Country Race spanning across several regions.

**Prerequisite:** Gold Wristband Access

**Restriction:** Total Buggies & Off-Road

Navigate the uneven loose surfaces as you head near the airfield for a high-speed push on the asphalt roads to the finish.

**Restriction:** Class C 500 Total Rally

**Restriction:** Class B 600 Total Rally
